usedFor: Wildapricot holds memberships and invoices, and Razorpay receives a payment request through “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice Is Created” in Wildapricot, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Each invoice gets a shareable link with an amount and expiry, so members can pay.

watchOut: “Create Payment Link” can set partial payments and notifications, so check both first.
